asked_by: Ace, 2026-10-31: evaluate every original top-five alert individually with the SAME frozen entry, exit and cost assumptions, without portfolio admission limits; label each 'admitted' or 'skipped'; do not change stops, targets, models or rankings
status: attribution study on 2023 (already-studied data), simulation only; not investable, not a strategy, no permission to buy; 2024 data never read

inputs.alerts: CRYPTO_REPLAY_v1 rankings/shortlists_2023.csv.gz, population early, 1,825 per arm, arms summary, sequence, shuffled (control)
inputs.account_labels: CRYPTO_REPLAY_v1 run/trades_BASE_<arm>.csv.gz: decision ORDER = admitted, SKIP_* = skipped with the reason
inputs.volatility: vol20 = 20-day std of daily log close returns through the signal day (the model's own vol20 definition), from bars before the decision only

isolated_trade.engine: idxsig.crypto_replay.run with a one-alert shortlist and CRYPTO_REPLAY_v1's BASE Policy, equity 10,000 at the decision; the same code path as the account

analyses: A per arm: isolated outcomes of all alerts: fills, exit reasons, entry-day stops, mean and median net return, win rate, gross (pre-cost) vs net mean, cost per trade
B per arm: by frozen rank 1..5 and by within-arm score quintile: mean net return, win rate, model hit rate; Spearman rho between score and net return; top-minus-bottom quintile mean

C per arm: admitted vs skipped (and by skip reason): n, mean and median net return, win rate; skipped-minus-admitted mean with a signal-day bootstrap 95% interval; the same on the first alert of each consecutive-day run of one coin (overlapping alerts collapsed)

D per arm: cross-tab of the model's own label (hit = barrier up first on closes within 5 days; non-hit; censored) against the isolated trade outcome (TARGET, STOP, TIME_EXIT win/loss, other): P(target | hit), P(stop | hit), P(hit | target), entry-day stop rate
E per arm: entry-day stop rate and mean net return by vol20 tercile; share of alerts whose model barrier (max(10%, 3 vol20 sqrt5)) exceeds the 10% target; the stop in units of daily vol
F reproduce Ace's figures from the account ledgers (hits admitted, entry-day stops, cost attribution)

verdict_rules.Q1: YES if, in both model arms, Spearman rho > 0 and the top score quintile's mean net return exceeds the bottom's; NO if neither; MIXED otherwise
verdict_rules.Q2: CROWDED OUT if skipped alerts' mean net return exceeds admitted alerts' with the bootstrap interval above zero in a model arm; NOT CROWDED OUT if the interval is below zero or includes zero
verdict_rules.Q3: the trade matches the forecast if P(target before stop | model hit) >= 0.5; otherwise the predicted event does not translate into this trade

honesty: overlapping alerts: the same coin alerted on consecutive days is evaluated once per alert, so runs are over-weighted; analysis C also collapses them
isolated trades ignore cash and risk limits by design; their sum is not a portfolio result
daily bars, modelled costs, one already-studied year
